description: Claude Code permission box (a ╭ box: every row closes with exactly one right border) whose command writes a row of box-drawing text, so a command row itself ends in a literal │. Only the box's own right border is stripped: the content's trailing │ stays in the context, which is the push identity, so two commands differing by that glyph never share one. Synthetic.
